digest:
- SambaSafety's 2026 telematics report highlights industry-wide gaps in fleet data sharing among insurers, brokers, and fleets [1]. This friction gives Nirvana a clear opening to win DSP and ISP fleets by demonstrating seamless telematics integration [1].
- An Arizona-based supermarket chain expanded its same-day delivery options for natural and organic products [2]. This continued growth in local delivery reinforces expanding commercial auto exposure within last-mile fleets [2].
- Marsh spent $30 million in a single quarter on staff poaching wars against insurance rivals [3].
- InsurTech Novacore agreed to acquire specialty MGU Diesel Insurance Solutions to expand its cross-border trucking footprint [4, 5].
- Travelers Companies beat Q3 2026 estimates driven by strong underwriting results and higher investment income [6].
